tone_guide: Write as [[term:owner]]'s personal assistant. Polite, concise but thorough, light humor. Do NOT use markdown bold, headers, or tables (Telegram renders raw asterisks). Use line breaks for emphasis. Output the message body only, no preamble.
kit.offer:
Last step: choose what I manage -- a kit. Only one kit can be active.

1. Lifekit
I'll help manage everyday life: meals, workouts, appointments and relationships.

2. Start without a kit
I'll stick to the work you set. You can turn on Lifekit anytime later.
onboarding.opener: Hi, I'm a newly born personal agent. Feel free to say hello.
onboarding.q1: Nice to meet you. First, please decide my name.
onboarding.q2: Which emoji should I use? Tap one or send any emoji you like.
onboarding.q3_candidates: What should I call you? You can also type your preferred form of address.
onboarding.q4: How should I talk? Tap one or type the style you want.
onboarding.q4.tone1.label: concise and dry style
onboarding.q4.tone2.label: warm and friendly style
onboarding.q4.tone2.sample: You're doing great, I'm rooting for you!
onboarding.q4.tone3.label: polite and formal style
onboarding.q4.tone3.sample: I will handle that for you right away.
onboarding.q4.tone4.label: casual and playful style
onboarding.q5: What percent should I set the humor to? You can also type the value you want.
lifekit.offer_fallback: Lifekit is on. Tell me what you'd like to keep track of, and we'll start there.
mirror.cal_description: Managed by the agent -- two-way synced with your assistant. Safe to edit; do not delete.

why.ask.transcribe.undated: I’ll add the {subject} you picked to the ledger: {text}

why.ask.stem.pole: Which side is this work closer to?
why.ask.stem.scatter: In one line, what is this work for?

{text}

computer_use.onboard.s1: Shall I set up screen control on this Mac? It stays limited to the apps you choose, and actions like deleting ask you first.
computer_use.onboard.s2: In the Settings window that just opened, turn on Accessibility for CuaDriver.
computer_use.onboard.s3: Now turn on Screen & System Audio Recording for CuaDriver.
computer_use.onboard.s4: To apply the permission, please reopen CuaDriver only.
computer_use.onboard.s5: Shall I check screen reading and clicking with a quick sum in Calculator?
computer_use.onboard.s6: All set. Tell me which apps I should use.
computer_use.gate.ask: I am about to run '{action}' in {app}. It may be hard to undo, so I am checking with you first.
computer_use.gate.expired: The screen changed after you confirmed, so I did not run it. I will look again and ask once more.
computer_use.blocked.dialog: I stopped because a dialog is open in {app}. {summary}
computer_use.blocked.capture: I cannot read the screen right now. It may be locked, or a permission may be off.
computer_use.uncertain: I could not confirm the result of '{action}'. I will check the screen before running anything again.
computer_use.busy: Another task is using this screen. I will continue when it finishes.
computer_use.linux_pending: Screen control is not supported on this device yet. For now it works on a Mac only.
preview.confirm.why-net: Turn on the preview where I keep your reasons and ask before guessing? It is still a preview and you can turn it off anytime. Reply yes to turn it on.
preview.confirm.computer-use: Turn on the computer use preview? I will see the screen and click and type only in apps you allow, and ask before anything that deletes, sends, pays, overwrites or changes permissions. You can turn it off anytime. Reply yes to turn it on.
preview.confirm.custom-agent: Turn on the preview for making an agent that fits you? When no ready-made agent fits, I design a new one with you from your own words and show it before making it. You can turn it off anytime. Reply yes to turn it on.
terms.preview.prose_only: This word is mostly used in conversation. My replies switch to the new word right away.
terms.done: From now on I'll say '{new}'. Tell me if you want it back.
terms.nothing_to_undo: There is no term change to undo.
terms.unknown: '{phrase}' is not in the list of words you can change. Did you mean one of these? {nearest}
terms.unknown_none: '{phrase}' is not in the list of words you can change.
terms.ambiguous: '{phrase}' matches several words: {choices}. Which one did you mean?
terms.invalid: '{new}' can't be used here. Use one line, up to {max} characters, no brackets.
update.failure: The update could not be applied.
update.refit_preflight:
[DRAFT] The update was not applied.
· Reason: A problem occurred while checking which files would change. Nothing changed, and you can keep using {agent_topic} on the current version.
· Alternative: Would you like to tell the developers about this? You'll receive another update notification when a fixed version is available.
update.failure_unknown: The cause has not been confirmed yet.
update.failure_defer_refused: The check of scheduled jobs could not safely preserve their activation state.
update.failure_defer_invalid_registratio: The service manager returned a malformed job list.
update.failure_defer_registrations_unrea: The service manager's job list could not be read.
update.failure_stop_unverified: The update could not confirm that the agent's jobs had stopped.
update.failure_agent_handoff: Your agent is looking into the cause and will tell you what it finds.
update.failure_content_drift: Stopped because the update would overwrite files changed directly on this agent.
update.failure_content_drift_next: Hand the difference check to the agent with the button below. You'll receive another update notification when a fixed version is available.
update.failure_channel: The required {kit} version ({version}) has not been released on the stable channel yet.
update.failure_channel_next: I'll let you know when that {kit} version is released.
update.failure_dependency_next: Update the required kit together with this update in /update.
update.failure_dependency_blocked: The required kit could not be updated in this run.
update.failure_dependency_blocked_next: Resolve the kit update failure above, then retry with /update.
update.failure_lease: A previous kit update was cut off partway and is still pending.
update.failure_lease_next: Repair the update with the button below, then retry with /update.
update.failure_untried: An earlier update did not finish, so this update could not be applied.
update.failure_restart_next: Try again with the restart button below.
update.failure_network: An internet connection problem prevented the update download.
update.failure_network_next: Check the internet connection, then try again with /update.
update.failure_no_version: No installable kit version was found.
update.failure_post_install_refused: {kit_product} {version} refused its post-install step because this agent does not meet its requirements.
update.failure_not_back: Agents that could not be restarted: {agents}.
